idea-plugin.name: k6 Companion
idea-plugin.description:
A Run Configuration for k6 load test scripts, plus a tool window for k6's `--summary-export` JSON. A real paid competitor's reviewers reported: "it doesn't respect Macros (despite allowing macros to be used)... configuration errors saying the file does not exist" -- this plugin explicitly expands path macros (`PathMacroManager`) before ever touching the filesystem, for both the script path and the k6 executable path.

Another cited complaint: "the terminal output for the 'animated progress bar' has been an issue for 2 years... makes the plugin nearly unusable." This plugin renders process output through the platform's own native `ConsoleView` (`CommandLineState`), not a hand-rolled terminal emulator. No WSL support in v1 -- not promising what the competitor doesn't reliably deliver either.
